Name: Slightly Sexier Willy - Portrait Replacement
Author: heehoohaha
Description:
you would never believe it from the sort of mods i make but i'm a straight man
anyway! does what it says on the tin, content patcher mod that changes willy's portraits, if you have any other mods that change portraits they might override this one, also i've not made it compatible with seasonal outfits (though ig i could upon request)

if ur downloading the looking for love compatible version just drag and drop the assets folder into [CP] Looking For Love, it'll come up with a popup message asking if u want to replace a file, say yes

Manifest.Name: Slightly Sexier Willy
Manifest.Description: Makes Willy's portrait a little prettier, while keeping in line with the game's art style and design
Manifest.Author: heehoohaha

Downloads.Description: download this if you're using this mod in combination with Looking For Love
